title: OpenCode Session Isolation — 1 shell N sessions, 1 session N shells

rows.what: Server must route requests by sessionId in URL path for multi-session support
rows.requirement:
given multiple OpenCode sessions are running simultaneously on one port
when any HTTP request arrives at /api/*
then the server must extract sessionId from /s/<sessionId>/api/... URL path, look up the session in a Map<sessionId, SessionContext> registry, and route to the correct session-scoped handler
rows.dod:
- All routes change from /api/* to /s/<sessionId>/api/*
- SessionRegistry Map<sessionId, SessionContext> replaces closure-based state
- Each session resolves its own plan/approve/deny/context independently
- Session context resolved from URL path prefix, not closure

rows.what: Concurrent session limit must be enforced
rows.requirement:
given multiple submit_plan calls can arrive concurrently from different OpenCode sessions
when a new session is started
then the server must check the registry count against MAX_SESSIONS (default 10, configurable via PLANNOTATOR_MAX_SESSIONS) and reject with an actionable error if at limit
rows.dod:
- PLANNOTATOR_MAX_SESSIONS env var controls limit (default 10)
- New session returns error listing active sessions and wait guidance when at limit
- Registry checked atomically before session registers
rows.intention: Prevent resource exhaustion from runaway agent loops. Without this, concurrent sessions on the same machine are possible but unbounded.

rows.what: Decision promises must be keyed by sessionId for independent resolution
rows.requirement:
given multiple sessions are running simultaneously on one port
when a user approves or denies one specific session
then only that session's decision promise resolves — all other sessions continue waiting independently
rows.dod:
- Map<sessionId, DecisionPromise> replaces single decisionPromise
- resolveDecision(sessionId, result) resolves only the correct session's promise
- waitForDecision(sessionId) returns the correct session's promise
- No cross-contamination between concurrent approvals/denials
rows.intention: Each concurrent session must resolve its own decision independently. Without keyed promises, a deny in one session would accidentally deny all sessions.
rows.user_words: support multiple session / plans running at the same time
notes: INTENTION-001 describes decision resolution per session
rows.review_goal: grep 'decisionPromise\|waitForDecision\|resolveDecision' packages/server/index.ts — verify Map keyed by sessionId not single closure variable
rows.solution: In packages/server/index.ts: replace single decisionPromise closure variable with Map<sessionId, {promise, resolve, reject}>; update waitForDecision(sessionId) and resolveDecision(sessionId, result) to use the map.
rows.file_line: packages/server/index.ts — replace single decisionPromise with Map<sessionId, DecisionPromise>

_verified_findings.port_fallback_root_cause: Bun bundles err.code as undefined in production builds — only err.message is reliable. Fix: errMsg.toLowerCase().includes('in use') or errCode==='EADDRINUSE'.
_verified_findings.three_server_concurrent_test: PASSED — 3 servers preferring port 19437 all started on unique ports via Bun.serve({port:0}) fallback. 5 rapid launches all succeeded.
_verified_findings.sse_versus_polling: EventSource (browser-only) not available in Bun runtime. Plugin uses 1-second polling fallback. SSE endpoint kept for browser clients.
_verified_findings.plan_server_vs_annotate_server: Only plannotator archive starts the full plan server (has /api/sessions). Plugin must connect to the plan server. PLANNOTATOR_SERVER_URL must point to a plan-mode server.
